outline.h2: Garena Player ID ni qayerdan topasiz
outline.covers: O'yinni oching -> yuqori o'ng burchakdagi Settings -> User Settings -> pastda, Legal and Privacy yonida Player ID turadi. Faqat raqamlarni bo'sh joysiz nusxa ko'chirish, nickname bilan adashtirmaslik, ID o'zgarmasligi. Batafsil versiya farqi uchun codm-garena-global-farqi ga havola.

UzCard, HUMO, Click, Payme, Paynet — hammasi so'mda. Visa/Mastercard, kriptovalyuta, xorijiy hamyon va VPN kerak emas. Konvertatsiya yo'q, chunki to'lov ichki tizimda o'tadi. To'lov cheki botda saqlanadi.

outline.h2: Narx qanday shakllanadi va nega saytda raqam yo'q
outline.covers: Narx provayder narxi (dollarda) + valyuta/USDT kursi + tanlangan paket hajmiga bog'liq va kun davomida o'zgaradi. Shuning uchun aniq so'm summasi faqat botda, paket tanlangan paytda ko'rsatiladi. Hech qanday taxminiy raqam yozilmaydi; kattaroq paketlarda bonus CP bo'lishi mumkinligi tushuntiriladi.

To'lovdan oldin bot ID ga bog'langan o'yin nikini ko'rsatadi — bu noto'g'ri akkauntga CP ketishining oldini oladigan yagona real himoya. Nik notanish bo'lsa to'lamaslik kerak. Tekshiruv bepul va majburiyat yuklamaydi.

outline.h2: CP qancha vaqtda keladi va ko'rinmasa nima qilish
outline.covers: Odatda ~3 daqiqa, band vaqtda 5 daqiqagacha. Tez tekshiruv ro'yxati: o'yindan to'liq chiqib qayta kirish, CP balansini yangilash, pochta (Mail) bo'limini ko'rish, buyurtma holatini botdan tekshirish. Chuqurroq holatlar uchun codm-cp-kelmadi-nima-qilish ga havola.

outline.h2: Xavfsizlik: sizdan hech qachon parol so'ralmaydi
outline.covers: To'ldirish faqat Player ID orqali bo'ladi. Parol, SMS/OTP kod, Garena akkauntiga kirish yoki ekranni ulashish so'ragan har qanday sotuvchi — firibgar. Akkaunt almashish yoki 'region o'zgartirish' xizmatlari bloklanish xavfini tug'diradi.
@Gempayuz_bot ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri havola, Player ID ni tayyorlab qo'yish eslatmasi, qo'llab-quvvatlash @StarsPaymeeSupport va /oyinlar/call-of-duty-mobile sahifasiga havola.

faq.q: Call of Duty: Mobile CP ni O'zbekistondan sotib olsa bo'ladimi?
faq.a: Ha. GemPay Telegram mini ilovasi O'zbekiston kartalarini qabul qiladi: UzCard, HUMO, Click, Payme va Paynet. Visa/Mastercard, kriptovalyuta yoki VPN kerak emas — to'lov to'g'ridan-to'g'ri so'mda o'tadi.

faq.q: To'ldirish uchun login va parol kerakmi?
faq.a: Yo'q, faqat Garena Player ID kerak. GemPay hech qachon parol, SMS kod yoki akkauntga kirishni so'ramaydi. Parol so'ragan sotuvchidan voz keching — bu akkauntni yo'qotishning eng keng tarqalgan yo'li.
Odatda 3 daqiqa atrofida, band vaqtlarda 5 daqiqagacha cho'zilishi mumkin. Agar shundan keyin ham ko'rinmasa, o'yindan to'liq chiqib qayta kiring va pochta (Mail) bo'limini tekshiring.

faq.q: Narxlar qayerda ko'rsatiladi va nega saytda yozilmagan?
faq.a: Narx botda paketni tanlaganingizda real vaqtda chiqadi. Provayder narxi va valyuta kursi kun davomida o'zgargani uchun saytda qat'iy so'm summasi yozilmaydi. Botdagi raqam har doim dolzarb bo'ladi.

GemPay CP ni Garena SG/MY Player ID bo'yicha to'ldiradi. Global akkaunt ID si bu yerda ishlamaydi, chunki ikkala versiya butunlay alohida tizim. Qaysi versiya sizda ekanini aniqlash uchun Garena va Global farqi qo'llanmasini o'qing.
Yo'q, u mutlaqo bepul va to'lovdan oldin bajariladi. Bot ID ga bog'langan o'yin nikini ko'rsatadi. Nik sizniki bo'lmasa — to'lamang va ID ni qayta nusxa ko'chiring.

faq.q: To'lovdan keyin buyurtmani bekor qilsa bo'ladimi?
faq.a: To'lov tasdiqlangach buyurtma darhol provayderga uzatiladi, shuning uchun bekor qilish deyarli imkonsiz. Aynan shu sabab Player ID va nikni to'lovdan oldin tekshirish shart. Muammoli holatda @StarsPaymeeSupport ga murojaat qiling.

competitorResearch: VERIFIED ONLINE: (1) Garena vs Global are two fully separate games — separate publishers (Garena SEA vs Activision), servers, accounts, redeem codes and CP economies; a Garena SG/MY Player ID does NOT work for Global top-ups and vice versa (lootbar, brgeeks, seagm, elitedias). (2) Attempting to transfer/shift an account between builds is punishable by ban — confirmed in multiple community/guide sources, so the region article must WARN, not advise. (3) Player ID location confirmed twice: in-game Settings (top-right) -> User Settings -> Player ID shown at the bottom near 'Legal and Privacy'. (4) Garena SG/MY CP tiers are odd-numbered with bonus CP (114 / 230+23 / 460+69 / 690+104 / 1150+173 / 2300+460 / 4600+1840 / 6858+2744 / 11429+4572 on SEAGM) and differ from Global's round 500/1100/2400/5000 — useful proof that 'which version' changes what you buy. (5) Battle Pass ~560 CP; Lucky Draw is an escalating ladder (25/70/180/360/580/900/1400/2800/4000 CP in one Garena draw, ~10,315 CP total). (6) Codashop's own guidance: they never ask for PlayerID AND password — good trust framing. COMPETITION READ (verified): the Uzbek-language SERP for CODM top-up is effectively EMPTY. Searches in Uzbek Latin ('codm cp to'ldirish o'zbekiston', 'call of duty mobile cp sotib olish uzbekistan') return only YouTube gameplay clips and irrelevant Telegram-bot blog posts — zero commercial pages. The Russian CODM SERP is owned by .ru donate shops (donatov.net, dem-gold, coolgameservice, szmarket, kupikod, ggsel, funpay) plus Codashop KZ — none of which accept UzCard/HUMO/so'm, so 'узбекистан / сум / humo uzcard' modifiers are wide open. By contrast the Uzbek PUBG UC SERP is already contested (Midasbuy UZ, Payme blog, 1pay.uz, hablax, mtcgame, milliysavdo.store) — proof that Uzbek-language money pages DO rank here, and that CODM is the same opportunity with no incumbent. The Telegram-Premium niche (uzgets.uz, starsjoy.uz) shows the exact winning page pattern for this audience: Uzbek Latin + 'so'm' + UzCard/Humo/Click/Payme + bot. INFERRED (not verified with volume data — Ahrefs and Semrush connectors are unauthorized in this session, so there are NO real volume/KD numbers here): relative ordering of the keyword lists, the transliterated spellings ('kod mobayl', 'codm'), and the assumption that a meaningful share of Uzbek CODM players sit on the Garena SG/MY build. That last assumption is exactly why article #2 is written as an identification guide rather than a recommendation — a Global-account reader must be told the honest answer, not pushed into a purchase.
